text:
eval-bot: nightly-eval finished for model redwood-v2-q8 (commit abc123) — tool/function-calling check shows 14% schema failures (baseline ~0.4%). attaching a couple of raw outputs we flagged.

anya: yikes, 14% is massive. do we have minimal examples?

eval-bot: yep, flagged examples below (raw model text). common patterns: trailing commas, single quotes, args serialized as string, and missing required fields.

sam: can you paste one?

eval-bot: example 1:
```json
{
  "tool": "search",
  "args": {"query": "climate change", },
}
```
example 2 (args serialized):
```json
{
  "tool": "open_file",
  "args": "{\"path\": \"/etc/config.yaml\", \"line\": 42}"
}
```
example 3 (single quotes + missing tool):
```json
{
  'args': {'id': 123},
  'note': 'should call db.get_record'
}
```

miguel: fwiw i saw similar after q8 quant run last month but only at ~1%. could be a change in tokenization or generation decode (we changed the stop sequence handling in runtime).

ryan: are failures concentrated on specific prompts or spread?

eval-bot: concentrated on prompts that trigger short function calls (1-3 tokens for args), and on prompts with many punctuation marks. i can dump the top 50 failing prompt ids.

olivia: quick mitigation: add schema-validation filter in the eval pipeline that rejects non-parseable JSON and marks call as failed but doesn't promote model. also for hosted runtime we can fallback to redwood-v2 (non-quant) for toolcall routes until triage.

sam: agree on the fallback. also we should try running local beam/greedy different decoding to see if it's a sampling artifact. can someone repro with the nightly config?

anya: I'll collect 50 failing prompts + model outputs and put them in s3://redwood-evals/triage/1772048123/ by EOD. will include the exact decode params and tokenizer state.

miguel: i'll run a reproduce matrix: {model=redwood-v2-q8, commit=abc123} x {temp=0.0,0.2,0.6} x {beam=1,5} and log raw tokens. will try both old stop-seq codepath and new one.

ryan: if it's quantization-induced, we should test the same commit unquantized (redwood-v2) to confirm. if unquantized is clean, this is a quant regression.

sam: possible quick fix in runtime: post-process toolcall outputs with a "safe-json" step that attempts to: 1) replace single quotes -> double 2) strip trailing commas 3) unescape double-encoded strings and then run strict schema validation. only use heuristics for eval, not for production live calls.

olivia: runtime team: do not auto-correct in production without review. but a read-only post-processing step for the nightly-eval reports is fine.

anya: noted. I'll also include the failing token sequences in the upload so we can see whether the model injected a specific token pattern before the malformed json.

miguel: opened GH issue eng-ml/triage #482: "v2-q8 toolcall output malformed JSON spikes in nightly eval" with a link to the S3 dump and reproduction commands. tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml.

sam: next steps: 1) pin hosted toolcall routes to redwood-v2 for 24-48h, 2) run reproduce matrix (miguel), 3) collect failing prompts + tokens (anya), 4) add eval-only post-processor (sam/olivia), 5) triage meeting tomorrow 10am PT.

ryan: i'll schedule the triage and add an agenda: compare token logs, tokenizer diffs, stop-seq change, quantization kernel update.

anya: uploaded initial batch to s3 and linked in GH issue.

miguel: first repro runs show the trailing-comma case appears when the model emits 0x2C token (comma) followed by EOS; seems like truncation interacts badly with our JSON cut heuristics. more runs incoming.

sam: thanks. if anyone finds a quick pattern (e.g., always when args length < 30 chars) ping me and i'll draft a hotfix for the eval parser.

olivia: noted. rolling the hosted fallback now (pin toolcall endpoints to redwood-v2) — will monitor errors. :lock:

anya: thanks all — i'll post updates in this thread when uploads and logs finish.

ryan: thanks team. triage tomorrow. :calendar:
